topic: One growth assumption moves a 30 year projection by over a million euros

assumptions.notes: Eva: €50,000 invested plus €1,000 added monthly for 30 years. Ending balances at 4%, 6% and 8% real annual growth are €847k, €1.26M and €1.91M (monthly contributions, annual effective rate). The gap between 4% and 8% is €1.06M. Monthly multipliers of 700, 1,000 and 1,400 are the rounded 30 year future value of €1 a month at the same three rates and cover monthly contributions only. All figures illustrative.

caption.instagram:
One input moved Eva's answer by more than a million euros.

A projection looks precise, but one input does most of the work: the growth rate. Same €50,000, same €1,000 a month, same 30 years, and three growth assumptions end €1.06M apart.

For your own quick range, multiply what you invest each month by 700, 1,000 and 1,400. That covers monthly contributions only. Money already invested grows separately.
